thread:
maria: Heads-up — opened PR #3482 to change how on-prem auth loads service account keys. It updates secrets.yaml and adds an optional KMS-backed flow. Please review: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/3482

ajay: Looking now. main question: does this broaden secret access? where's the key stored on-prem?

maria: Key stays in customer HSM by default; fallback to encrypted file in /etc/redwood/keys if HSM not available. Added config flag `auth.kms.enabled`.

kevin: @maria can you paste the minimal config snippet? need to check our ansible templates for deploy.

maria: Block:
```
auth:
  kms:
    enabled: true
    key_ref: projects/..../locations/../keyRings/../cryptoKeys/..
``` 

lisa: Quick security ask: does enabling kms:true require additional network egress from on-prem to cloud KMS? Customer networks may block that.

maria: Good point — flow is optional. If enabled and using cloud KMS, yes it will need outgoing TLS to KMS endpoint. Added doc note. Also added a service-mode `local-only` that uses file + HSM.

ajay: From infra side, if cloud KMS is selected, we should gate behind explicit opt-in and a runtime warning. Also mark feature flag so we can detect in telemetry.

kevin: I spotted a TODO in PR about rotating the fallback file. We should auto-rotate or recommend a cron in docs.

maria: Added rotation script and doc snippet. See `scripts/rotate-keys.sh` in PR.

security-bot: CI: static-secrets-scan passed. iam-checks failed (missing binding for service-account:VaultUnseal).

lisa: @maria can you add the iam binding change to the helm chart values? We need it for Dedicated QA.

maria: Will add. Question: is this safe to merge into main during the current freeze window? Our merge policy says no changes to auth before Tue deploy.

ajay: We have a minor maintenance window tomorrow 03:00 UTC. If this requires infra config, hold until after. Otherwise can merge to integration branch for further testing.

maria: Ok — I'll branch to `integration/onprem-kms` and open a follow-up PR for helm values after approvals. Requesting @lisa and @kevin approvals for design + @ajay for infra sign-off. :pray: 

kevin: Quick review done — design LGTM, but add a note in audit logs when fallback key used.

lisa: LGTM from security once IAM binding is added to values and the audit log note present.

ajay: Infra OK with opt-in + telemetry. Move to integration branch.

maria: Thanks all. Moving to integration/onprem-kms and will ping when follow-up PR is ready. :shipit:
